update(**params)[source]¶

Updates the recorded data with the new sample.

get(varname, node_name=None)[source]¶

Get the recorded values of a queried variable. It also allows the retrieval of a particular neuron or input node. If no neuron is fixed, it returns the records of all the records of the requested var. =========================================================================== - Args:

varname [str] : name of the monitored variable. node_name [str or None] : name of the node or neuron.
